verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Krishna said: I taught this unchanging yoga to Vivasvan, the Sun. Vivasvan taught it to Manu, and Manu taught it to King Ikshvaku.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप
verses.tr: Handed down in this way from teacher to student, the royal sages knew it. But over a long time, this yoga was lost to the world, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः
भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम्
verses.tr: Today I have told you that same ancient yoga, because you are my devotee and my friend. It is the highest secret.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
skt: अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः
verses.tr: Arjuna said: You were born recently, and Vivasvan was born long ago. How am I to understand that you taught it to him in the beginning?

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन
तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप
verses.tr: Krishna said: Many births of mine have passed, and of yours too, Arjuna. I know them all; you do not.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Though I am unborn and unchanging, and the Lord of all beings, I take birth through my own power, by governing my own nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत
verses.tr: Whenever goodness declines and wrongdoing rises, Arjuna, then I bring myself forth.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: To protect the good, to end the work of the wicked and to set dharma firmly in place again, I appear in age after age.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन
verses.tr: One who truly understands that my birth and actions are divine is not born again after leaving the body. That person comes to me, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Free from craving, fear and anger, absorbed in me and taking refuge in me, many have been purified by the fire of knowledge and have reached my state.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्
verses.tr: However people come to me, in that same way I respond to them. Everyone, in every way, is following my path, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः
क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा
verses.tr: Those who want quick success in their work worship the gods here, because in the human world, results from actions come quickly.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: I created the four orders of society according to people's qualities and work. Though I made them, know me as the non-doer, unchanging.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा
इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते
verses.tr: Actions do not stain me, and I have no desire for their results. One who knows me in this way is not bound by actions either.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः
कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम्
verses.tr: Knowing this, even seekers of freedom in ancient times did their work. So you too should act, as the ancients did long ago.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: What is action and what is inaction? Even the wise are confused about this. I will explain action to you; knowing it, you will be free from harm.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः
verses.tr: One must understand right action, wrong action and inaction. The way of action is deep and hard to grasp.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः
स बुद्धिमान् मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत्
verses.tr: One who sees inaction in action and action in inaction is wise among people. Such a person is steady in yoga while doing all kinds of work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: When all of someone's undertakings are free from selfish desire and scheming, and their actions are burned up in the fire of knowledge, the wise call that person learned.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Giving up attachment to results, always content and depending on nothing, such a person does nothing at all, even while fully engaged in work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Expecting nothing, with mind and self under control, letting go of all possessiveness, doing only what the body needs, such a person incurs no fault.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते
verses.tr: Content with whatever comes without asking, beyond opposites like pleasure and pain, free from envy, the same in success and failure, such a person is not bound even while acting.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: For one who is unattached and free, whose mind rests in knowledge, and who works as an offering, all action dissolves completely.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: The offering is Brahman, the oblation is Brahman, poured by Brahman into the fire that is Brahman. One who sees Brahman in every action reaches Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Some yogis offer sacrifice to the gods. Others offer the sacrifice itself into the fire of Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Some offer hearing and the other senses into the fires of restraint. Others offer sound and the other sense objects into the fires of the senses.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Others offer all the actions of the senses and of the life breath into the fire of self-control, lit by knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Some offer their wealth, some offer austerity, some offer yoga practice, and some, firm in their vows, offer study of scripture and knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Others, devoted to breath control, offer the outgoing breath into the incoming and the incoming into the outgoing, holding the flow of both.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Others, eating with restraint, offer the life breaths into the life breaths. All of these know the meaning of sacrifice, and through it their faults are washed away.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Those who eat what remains of the sacrifice, which is like nectar, reach eternal Brahman. Even this world is not for one who offers nothing; how could any other be?

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे
verses.tr: Many kinds of sacrifice are described in the Vedas. Know that all of them are born of action. Knowing this, you will be free.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: The sacrifice of knowledge is better than any sacrifice of material things, Arjuna. All action, without exception, finds its fulfilment in knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Learn it by bowing humbly, by asking sincere questions and by serving. The wise who have seen the truth will teach you this knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Knowing it, you will never fall into such confusion again, Arjuna. Through it you will see all beings in yourself, and then in me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Even if you were the worst of all wrongdoers, you would cross over all wrong by the boat of knowledge alone.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Just as a blazing fire turns wood to ashes, Arjuna, so the fire of knowledge turns all actions to ashes.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते
verses.tr: Nothing in this world purifies like knowledge. One who has grown perfect in yoga finds it within, in time.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: A person of faith, devoted to it and with senses under control, gains knowledge. Having gained knowledge, they soon reach supreme peace.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः
verses.tr: One who is ignorant, without faith and full of doubt is ruined. For the doubting mind there is neither this world, nor the next, nor happiness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: One who has given up actions through yoga, whose doubts are cut away by knowledge, and who is centred in the Self, is not bound by actions, Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: So with the sword of knowledge cut away this doubt in your heart, born of ignorance. Take up yoga. Stand up, Arjuna!
